data: You attempt to charm a creature, sharply decreasing its attack. A target you choose in range must make a {save}. On a fail, the target adds -2 to all attack rolls against you for the duration.
The target adds -3 at level 5, -4 at level 10, and -5 at level 17.
Badly startles Pokémon that the audience has high expectations of.
Pokemon that has the highest Visual Round score must make a CHA Saving Throw against Intimidation/Persuasion DC.
